concepts.definition: Feature closing, visibility, human proxy and CLI behavior are product requirements above language, HoG traversal and ABG admission law.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-001**: Product policy (feature closing, visibility rules, human proxy mode, CLI behavior) shall be expressed as product-layer requirements, not GTL language law, HoG traversal law, or ABG admission law.

**REQ-P-POLICY-002**: Policy may consume GTL tags, evaluator results, and convergence state, but policy logic shall not be embedded in GTL validation or the HoG traversal kernel.

**REQ-P-POLICY-003**: CLI and control-plane summaries shall be product-layer projections over canonical ABG run truth. They shall not define independent boolean lifecycle truth that can contradict the canonical run/event model.

concepts.label: Product-layer policy

concepts.definition: Repeated proof failures on current identity become control-plane hold from canonical proof_failed/proof_passed/scoped reset events, governed by one consumed enabled/threshold policy.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-005**: Repeated proof failure on one current work identity shall project to product-layer control-plane hold truth. That hold truth shall be replay-derived from canonical `proof_failed`, `proof_passed`, and scoped `reset` events rather than hidden controller memory or a rival mutable run-state store.

**REQ-P-POLICY-006**: Product-layer proof-hold behavior shall resolve through one consumed hold-policy surface. That resolved surface shall govern whether hold is enabled and the failure threshold. Any runtime specialization shall resolve into that one product-consumed policy surface rather than becoming CLI-local truth.

**REQ-P-POLICY-007**: The proof-hold identity shall be keyed by `edge`, `work_key`, `spec_hash`, and `workflow_version`. Hold projection shall survive process restart and shall clear only by lawful replay-visible causes: proof success on the same identity, identity supersession by new `spec_hash` or `workflow_version`, or an explicit scoped `reset` over the held boundary.

**REQ-P-POLICY-008**: Product-layer advancement and observation surfaces shall consume the same proof-hold projection. `start`, `gaps`, and live run status may report hold, but they shall not redefine ABG run lifecycle truth in order to do so.

concepts.label: Replay-derived proof hold

concepts.definition: start request grammar is scope + public target + until; supervision and F_H proxying are orthogonal Product control modes.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-009**: `start` traversal request truth shall be expressed as `scope + target + until`. Supervision, F_H proxying, and similar recovery behavior shall be modeled as orthogonal product-policy control modes outside that traversal request grammar.

**REQ-P-POLICY-010**: When product policy publishes `asset:<published_handle>` as a `start` target family, that family shall resolve only through one published operator asset registry and ownership surface. Each published asset handle shall resolve to one governing traversal boundary, and unresolved, unowned, unsupported, or ambiguously owned asset handles shall fail closed.

**REQ-P-POLICY-011**: The current public `start` control-mode families shall be:
- `fh_mode`
- `root_mode`
Those mode families are product-policy truth above the adapter. Literal flags or service parameters are bindings of those same mode families, not the source of truth for them.

concepts.label: Public traversal request

concepts.definition: direct or supervised, with supervised default; lawful only for until=converged and outside traversal grammar. Supervised selects admitted system program/session policy owning convergence; direct selects one entry traversal without that overlay.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-013**: The current public `root_mode` values shall be:
- `direct`
- `supervised`
`supervised` is the default. It selects the admitted system program and session
policy that own convergence inside GTL/HoG/ABG; it does not authorize a CLI,
SDK, service, or installer loop around repeated starts. `direct` selects one
admitted entry traversal without that Product policy overlay. `root_mode` shall
remain outside `scope + target + until` and shall be lawful only when
`until = converged`.

concepts.label: root_mode control

concepts.definition: Reserved 5.1 native-human-interaction family with direct default or optional human-proxy review; lawful only until=converged outside traversal grammar.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-012**: Reserved for 5.1 native human interaction. Its `fh_mode` values are:
- `direct`
- `human-proxy`
`direct` is the default. `human-proxy` is a public operator option that may proxy F_H review under product policy. `fh_mode` shall remain outside `scope + target + until` and shall be lawful only when `until = converged`.

concepts.label: fh_mode control

concepts.definition: Admitted GTL declares the primary loop, HoG traverses and ABG admits its truth: refine assets, start admitted work, receive truthful stop/hold/gap, resolve roadblock in agentic coder, inspect and continue lawfully.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-014**: The primary operator workflow shall be an interactive
One Surface loop declared by an admitted GTL program, traversed by HoG, and
admitted as runtime truth by ABG. An
operator shall be able to define or refine current assets, invoke or start
admitted work, receive one truthful stop, hold, or gap signal, remove one
ambiguity or roadblock through the interactive agentic coder surface, inspect
the current projection, and continue the same lawful workflow without
inventing a second runtime or controller model.

concepts.label: Interactive One Surface workflow

concepts.definition: One versioned closed family shared by SDK/CLI owns operation identities/variants, request/result/refusal, authority/effect class, operation-indexed binding, capabilities and adapter coordinates; source-blind classification separates public read, runtime mutation/attestation, install/config, release and internal-only.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-019**: Abiogenesis shall publish one versioned public operation
contract shared by its SDK and command-line adapter. One closed
`PublicFunctionDefinition<K>` family shall own every operation identity,
variant, request/result/refusal contract, authority and effect class,
operation-indexed workspace-binding requirement, capability ref, and adapter
coordinate. The contract shall be source-blind and shall classify every
function as public read, public runtime mutation or attestation,
install/configuration operation, release operation, or internal-only behavior.

concepts.label: PublicFunctionDefinition<K>

concepts.definition: Admitted scope/target/until plus session policy/capabilities/view selects only public identities inside one admitted GTL program and returns Run/GraphCall identity, disposition, stop/terminal and result/gap/interaction/evidence/replay refs.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-023**: The `start` variant of
`abg.operation.run.invoke` shall accept one admitted traversal request with
`scope`, public `target`, and `until`, plus declared session policy and
capability inputs such as control modes and catalog view. It shall resolve only
public target identities inside one admitted GTL program and shall return a
typed run and GraphCall identity, current disposition, stop or terminal
classification, and relevant result, gap, interaction, evidence, and replay
references. Public ingress admits and transports the request. GTL owns the
selected program's topology and available routes, the validator checks its
static relations, HoG traverses it, selected implementation bindings realize
declared leaf effects, and ABG admits target selection, invocation, result,
evidence, continuation, and closure truth.

concepts.label: run.invoke start

concepts.definition: Existing admitted Run/continuation plus operator/declared input is validated by ABG for substrate, program, binding and declaration compatibility before lawful frontier resolution.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-024**: `abg.operation.run.continue` shall identify an existing
admitted run or continuation boundary, the acting operator, and any declared
continuation input. ABG shall validate substrate, admitted-program, binding, and
declaration compatibility and resolve the lawful frontier. The caller shall not
construct, select, or mutate private frame, frontier, continuation, traversal,
retry, intent, or action-selection state.

concepts.label: run.continue

concepts.definition: Read-only views of canonical admitted runtime/event/projection truth, including status, results, replay, gaps and lawful actions.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-026**: The runtime-status variant of
`abg.operation.project.read` shall be a read-only projection for an admitted run
or GraphCall identity. It shall report the canonical current disposition, stop
or terminal classification, active or pending interaction, relevant result,
gap, evidence, and replay references, and substrate identity without redefining
lifecycle truth.

**REQ-P-POLICY-027**: The result variant of
`abg.operation.project.read` shall be a read-only projection of an admitted
GraphCall or result identity. It shall preserve the declared result contract,
disposition, closure eligibility, residuals, evidence, artifact, assessment,
provenance, and replay references applicable to that result.

**REQ-P-POLICY-028**: The replay variant of
`abg.operation.project.read` shall be a read-only query over admitted event and
projection truth for a workspace, run, GraphCall, or supported subordinate
identity. Its ordering, cursor or range, event identities, source identities,
and projection basis shall be explicit. It shall not re-execute probabilistic
work or mutate runtime truth.

**REQ-P-POLICY-029**: The gaps variant of
`abg.operation.project.read` shall be a read-only replay-derived projection. It
shall expose typed stop, hold, gap, missing-capability, unresolved-observation,
and pending-human-interaction truth with implicated asset, GraphFunction,
reason, evidence, and replay references sufficient for the operator to choose a
lawful next interaction. Reading gaps shall not run `evalGap` or `evaluateNext`.

**REQ-P-POLICY-030**: The lawful-actions variant of
`abg.operation.project.read` shall project the current replay-derived
`NextActionProjection` at an admitted frontier. Each row shall identify its
action kind, public target or pending-interaction identity, eligibility or
blocker, required input or capability, provenance, and replay basis. Querying
actions shall not run `evaluateNext`, select, admit, or execute one.

concepts.label: project.read projections

concepts.definition: Reserved native select/approve/reject/assess/answer_escalation variants support an existing pending interaction and identify interaction, actor, declared response contract, value/choice, evidence and capability provenance.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-031**: Reserved for 5.1 native human interaction. The closed `select | approve | reject | assess |
answer_escalation` variants of `abg.operation.interaction.respond` shall support
an existing escalation or pending human interaction. Every request shall
identify the pending interaction, actor, declared decision or response contract,
supplied value or choice, evidence references, and capability provenance
required by that interaction.

**REQ-P-POLICY-032**: Reserved for 5.1 native human response admission. An F_H request that does not match one pending interaction,
declared choice or response contract, actor capability, or current basis shall
fail as a typed refusal. A human response shall be admitted as actor-attributed
truth; it shall not directly select private traversal, emit arbitrary runtime
events, or decide closure outside ABG projection law.

concepts.label: 5.1 interaction.respond

concepts.definition: result.assess admits expected F_P result/assessment/actor-capability/contract/evidence/current-basis truth; witness.admit covers reprice, attest, hygiene-stamp, intake, run-resumed and run-stopped.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-034**: `abg.operation.result.assess` shall admit assessed F_P result truth only
for the expected result, assessment, actor or capability, contract, evidence,
and current basis identities. Its output shall distinguish admitted, rejected,
blocked, and retry-eligible non-close truth. Assessing prose alone shall not
become runtime or closure truth.

**REQ-P-POLICY-035**: `abg.operation.witness.admit` shall retain the public acts `reprice`,
`attest`, `hygiene-stamp`, `intake`, `run-resumed`, and `run-stopped`. A witness
request shall identify its actor, subject, typed reason or payload, evidence,
and applicable run, segment, workspace, or basis. Each accepted witness act
shall be an actor-attributed admitted event.

concepts.label: Runtime assessment and witnessed acts

concepts.definition: Submitted GTL program receives typed program/inventory identity, pass/fail, stable diagnostics, violated law/contracts, evidence and admissible repair affordances.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-038**: The public `gtl_program` variant of
`abg.operation.conformance.evaluate` shall accept a submitted GTL program and
return a typed conformance result with program or inventory
identity, passed or failed disposition, stable diagnostics, violated law or
contract references, evidence, and admissible repair affordances. It shall not
silently repair or execute an inadmissible program.

concepts.label: gtl_program conformance.evaluate

concepts.definition: product.materialize, product.install and release.snapshot each publish exact request/result/refusal/provenance/exit contracts and affected workspace/product/configuration/release identities plus manifests/evidence.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-039**: `abg.operation.product.materialize` variants,
`abg.operation.product.install`, and `abg.operation.release.snapshot` shall each
publish exact request, result, refusal, provenance, and exit contracts. Their
outputs shall identify the affected workspace, product, configuration, or
release identities and the manifests or evidence that carry the operation
result.

**REQ-P-POLICY-040**: `abg.operation.release.snapshot` shall refuse a release
subject unless its exact same-subject and same-law-basis qualification verdict
is green with an empty bypass set. A snapshot or release cut shall be output
only; it shall not qualify itself or serve as candidate-freeze input.

concepts.label: Release snapshot

conditions: Repeated proof failure on the same edge/work_key/spec_hash/workflow_version under resolved enabled/threshold policy.
exceptions: Only replay-visible same-identity proof success, identity supersession or scoped reset clears hold.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-005**: Repeated proof failure on one current work identity shall project to product-layer control-plane hold truth. That hold truth shall be replay-derived from canonical `proof_failed`, `proof_passed`, and scoped `reset` events rather than hidden controller memory or a rival mutable run-state store.

**REQ-P-POLICY-006**: Product-layer proof-hold behavior shall resolve through one consumed hold-policy surface. That resolved surface shall govern whether hold is enabled and the failure threshold. Any runtime specialization shall resolve into that one product-consumed policy surface rather than becoming CLI-local truth.

**REQ-P-POLICY-008**: Product-layer advancement and observation surfaces shall consume the same proof-hold projection. `start`, `gaps`, and live run status may report hold, but they shall not redefine ABG run lifecycle truth in order to do so.

constraints.statement: Key hold by edge, work_key, spec_hash and workflow_version; survive process restart; clear only same-identity proof success, superseding spec_hash/workflow_version or explicit scoped reset. Runtime specialization resolves into the same consumed policy; start/gaps/status and advancement consume one projection without rival state or lifecycle redefinition.

conditions: Product policy publishes asset:<published_handle> target family.

grounding.quote: **REQ-P-POLICY-010**: When product policy publishes `asset:<published_handle>` as a `start` target family, that family shall resolve only through one published operator asset registry and ownership surface. Each published asset handle shall resolve to one governing traversal boundary, and unresolved, unowned, unsupported, or ambiguously owned asset handles shall fail closed.

constraints.statement: When asset:<published_handle> is published as a target, one operator registry/ownership surface maps each handle to one governing traversal boundary; unresolved, unowned, unsupported or ambiguous ownership fails closed.

conditions: Both control modes are lawful only with until=converged.
fh_mode native human behavior is reserved for 5.1.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-011**: The current public `start` control-mode families shall be:
- `fh_mode`
- `root_mode`
Those mode families are product-policy truth above the adapter. Literal flags or service parameters are bindings of those same mode families, not the source of truth for them.

**REQ-P-POLICY-012**: Reserved for 5.1 native human interaction. Its `fh_mode` values are:
- `direct`
- `human-proxy`
`direct` is the default. `human-proxy` is a public operator option that may proxy F_H review under product policy. `fh_mode` shall remain outside `scope + target + until` and shall be lawful only when `until = converged`.

**REQ-P-POLICY-013**: The current public `root_mode` values shall be:
- `direct`
- `supervised`
`supervised` is the default. It selects the admitted system program and session
policy that own convergence inside GTL/HoG/ABG; it does not authorize a CLI,
SDK, service, or installer loop around repeated starts. `direct` selects one
admitted entry traversal without that Product policy overlay. `root_mode` shall
remain outside `scope + target + until` and shall be lawful only when
`until = converged`.

constraints.statement: fh_mode/root_mode are Product truth; literal flags/service parameters only bind them. Supervised mode grants no CLI/SDK/service/installer loop over repeated starts.

conditions: When ABG yields observer/routing handoff, honor it before constructive redispatch.

grounding.quote: **REQ-P-POLICY-004**: Product-layer `start` control modes shall treat yielded ABG handoff truth as a lawful control seam. They shall not flatten yielded handoff into terminal success and shall not blindly redispatch the same constructive lane without first honoring the yielded observer or routing handoff.

**REQ-P-POLICY-016**: Product-layer stop, hold, and gap reporting for the
interactive operator workflow shall be explicit enough that an operator can
decide the next lawful action: continue by restarting `start`, inspect
with `gaps`, remove an ambiguity, satisfy a missing capability, or supply
human decision. Downstream wrappers shall not need to reconstruct that next
step from hidden controller-local state.

constraints.statement: Yielded ABG handoff is a lawful seam, never terminal success or blind redispatch before honoring observer/routing handoff. Stop/hold/gap reports must let operators choose start continuation, gaps inspection, ambiguity removal, missing capability or human decision without hidden controller state.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-018**: Gap triage shall be downstream product policy expressed
through published graph-function-addressable work. ABG may expose replay-derived
gap, hold, stop, continuation, and unresolved-observation truth, but it shall
not own ticket priority, ticket closure, backlog state, or process mechanics.
When a downstream product creates or changes a ticket from gap truth, that
behavior shall be governed by the downstream product and `TICKET_METHOD.md`.

constraints.statement: Gap triage is downstream policy expressed as published graph-function-addressable work. ABG exposes replay-derived gap/hold/stop/continuation/unresolved observations but owns no ticket priority/closure/backlog/process; downstream ticket changes follow its Product and TICKET_METHOD.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-020**: Each public operation contract row shall define its stable
operation identity, required and optional inputs, defaults, admitted value
domains, capability requirements, input and output contract identities,
successful and non-success dispositions, typed errors or refusals, exit
semantics, replay or provenance effects, whether it reads or changes truth, and
the operation-and-variant-indexed workspace-binding requirement
`forbidden | exactly_one`. No concrete variant shall carry a freely optional
binding, and no public adapter shall supply missing contract meaning from local
convention.

constraints.statement: Each row defines stable identity, required/optional inputs, defaults, value domains, capabilities, input/output contracts, success/non-success, errors/refusals, exits, replay/provenance and read/change effects. Workspace binding is per operation/variant forbidden or exactly_one, never freely optional; adapters supply no omitted meaning by convention.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-021**: The public operation set shall be the complete
Product-derived family in `REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-008`. Its derived count is
not Product authority. The closed variants shall retain
all of the following product behavior:

- workspace create, open, and immutable product binding;
- product verification, resolution, installation, context bootstrap, and
  configuration materialization;
- catalog admission, narrowing view derivation, list and describe projection,
  non-callable node-type and overlay application, and GraphFunction invocation;
- start and invoke through one run-invocation function, plus replay-derived
  continuation through one run-continuation function;
- status, result, evidence, replay, gap, and lawful-action reads through one
  typed projection function;
- F_H selection, approval, rejection, assessment, and escalation response;
- result assessment and witnessed-act admission;
- GTL-program conformance evaluation; and
- qualified RC and tapped-release snapshot materialization.

Tenant or host bindings may express a variant through ergonomic subcommands or
typed SDK methods, but shall bind one of those exact identities and shall not
retain a legacy identity, compatibility facade, parallel register, default, or
fallback. This is the STDO hard break.

Observer-report, observer-drafts, tuning-report, and tuning-transition
variants are planned 5.1 Product contracts. They are not members of the 5.0
public operation family.

constraints.statement: Complete Product-derived family retains workspace create/open/bind; product verify/resolve/install/bootstrap/configure; catalog admit/view/list/describe/noncallable apply/GraphFunction invoke; shared run invoke(start/invoke) and continue; one projection family status/result/evidence/replay/gap/actions; human selection/approval/rejection/assessment/escalation; result assessment/witness acts; GTL conformance; qualified RC/tapped snapshots. Count is derived, not authority. Host ergonomic commands/methods bind exact identities with no legacy identity/facade/register/default/fallback (hard break). Observer-report/drafts and tuning-report/transition are planned 5.1, outside 5.0.

conditions: Same admitted inputs and bound Product identities.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-022**: The public SDK and CLI shall expose equivalent operation
semantics. Given the same admitted inputs and bound product identities, they
shall preserve the same operation identity, validation, defaults, disposition,
typed result or refusal, event or provenance effects, and exit classification.

constraints.statement: Same admitted inputs and bound identities yield same SDK/CLI operation, validation, defaults, dispositions, result/refusal, event/provenance and exit classification.

conditions: root_mode direct selects one entry; supervised selects standard system program and its ordered semantic topology.
exceptions: Direct entry does not require One Surface, evaluateNext or ConstructionIntent.

grounding.quote:
references. Public ingress admits and transports the request. GTL owns the
selected program's topology and available routes, the validator checks its
static relations, HoG traverses it, selected implementation bindings realize
declared leaf effects, and ABG admits target selection, invocation, result,
evidence, continuation, and closure truth.

When `root_mode = direct`, `start` selects one admitted entry traversal without
requiring One Surface, `evaluateNext`, or a `ConstructionIntent`. When
`root_mode = supervised`, it selects the admitted standard system program and
that program owns One Surface semantic ordering and action topology;
Product-owned GraphFunctions own the four synthesis and evaluation contracts,
and ABG separately admits selected-action and construction-intent truth. Neither
the program nor HoG may mint runtime truth, and ABG shall not reorder semantic
authorities, select traversal topology, or become a scheduler.

constraints.statement: Ingress admits/transports; GTL owns topology/routes; validator static relations; HoG traversal; implementation bindings leaf effects; ABG target/invocation/result/evidence/continuation/closure facts. direct requires neither One Surface, evaluateNext nor ConstructionIntent. supervised selects standard admitted system program owning semantic ordering/action topology, with Product GraphFunctions owning four synthesis/evaluation contracts and ABG separately admitting action/intent. Program/HoG mint no runtime truth; ABG neither reorders semantic authorities nor selects topology/schedules.

program, immutable workspace binding, and public target may continue the primary
operator workflow only through current replay and admitted state. It shall not
create a caller-local continuation model or silently discard prior stop, hold,
gap, F_H, result, or provenance truth.

Repeated start over same program/binding/target may continue only from current replay/admitted state, never caller-local continuation or loss of prior stops/holds/gaps/F_H/results/provenance.

grounding.quote:

conditions: Useful work carrying unresolved obligations is permitted only while its prerequisites, constraints and authority remain valid.
Changed human-clarification basis requires affected-work reevaluation and lawful re-entry.
exceptions: Routine work under established specification requires no human approval stage.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-033**: The 5.0 public workflow uses the shared contract:
`run.invoke(start)` reaches automatic progression, a truthful stop/hold/gap or
terminal result, and `project.read` exposes the admitted frontier. Consequence
may propose useful declared work while carrying unresolved obligations only
when that work's prerequisites, constraints and authority remain valid. If no
lawful next step exists within declared limits, the result is a typed block
and human-readable handoff. Routine work under established specification does
not require a human approval stage. Automatic current-intent continuation and
new-action admission remain distinct; neither belongs to an adapter.

Native `interaction.respond` and response-driven same-run resumption are 5.1
scope. A human clarification that changes the basis requires evaluation of
affected work and lawful re-entry; it does not resume stale assumptions.

constraints.statement: 5.0 run.invoke(start) progresses automatically to truthful stop/hold/gap/terminal and project.read exposes frontier. Consequence may propose declared work with unresolved obligations only if its prerequisites, constraints and authority stay valid; no lawful step within limits yields typed block plus readable handoff. Routine established-spec work needs no human approval stage. Automatic current-intent continuation and new-action admission remain distinct and adapter-external. Native response-driven same-Run resumption is 5.1; human clarification changing basis requires affected-work evaluation and lawful re-entry, not stale resumption.

**REQ-P-POLICY-035**: `abg.operation.witness.admit` shall retain the public acts `reprice`,
`attest`, `hygiene-stamp`, `intake`, `run-resumed`, and `run-stopped`. A witness
request shall identify its actor, subject, typed reason or payload, evidence,
and applicable run, segment, workspace, or basis. Each accepted witness act
shall be an actor-attributed admitted event.

constraints.statement: Assessment distinguishes admitted, rejected, blocked and retry-eligible non-close; prose alone is not runtime/closure truth. Witness request binds actor, subject, typed reason/payload, evidence and applicable Run/segment/workspace/basis; accepted act yields actor-attributed admitted event.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-036**: Reserved for ABIogenesis 5.1. When selected, the
observer-report and observer-drafts variants of `abg.operation.project.read`
shall remain read-only replay-derived projections. They are not 5.0 public
operation variants.

**REQ-P-POLICY-037**: Reserved for ABIogenesis 5.1. When selected, the
tuning-report variant of `abg.operation.project.read` shall remain read-only,
and `abg.operation.tuning.transition` shall preserve admitted proposal,
ratification, and rejection authority. Neither identity is part of the 5.0
public operation family.

constraints.statement: Observer-report/drafts and tuning-report are reserved 5.1 read-only replay projections; tuning.transition preserves admitted proposal/ratification/rejection authority. They are not 5.0 family members.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-038**: The public `gtl_program` variant of
`abg.operation.conformance.evaluate` shall accept a submitted GTL program and
return a typed conformance result with program or inventory
identity, passed or failed disposition, stable diagnostics, violated law or
contract references, evidence, and admissible repair affordances. It shall not
silently repair or execute an inadmissible program.

constraints.statement: Conformance evaluation neither silently repairs nor executes an inadmissible program.

conditions: Exact same-subject/same-law green verdict with empty bypass set is required before release snapshot.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-040**: `abg.operation.release.snapshot` shall refuse a release
subject unless its exact same-subject and same-law-basis qualification verdict
is green with an empty bypass set. A snapshot or release cut shall be output
only; it shall not qualify itself or serve as candidate-freeze input.

constraints.statement: Refuse a release subject unless exact same-subject/same-law-basis qualification verdict is green with empty bypass set. Snapshot/release cut is output only, neither self-qualifying nor candidate-freeze input.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-041**: Every 5.0 catalog, runtime, evidence, replay, gap, and
lawful-action variant of
`abg.operation.project.read` shall be a pure public read. A read shall admit no
runtime mutation event and shall not change installed, bound, catalog, run,
continuation, draft, assessment, intent, selection, or closure truth.

constraints.statement: Every 5.0 catalog/runtime/evidence/replay/gap/actions read is pure: no runtime mutation event or change of installed, bound, catalog, Run, continuation, draft, assessment, intent, selection or closure truth.

conditions: Accepted variant changes or attests runtime truth.
exceptions: Install/config/release produce their boundary-appropriate manifests/provenance rather than ordinary traversal events.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-042**: `run.invoke`, `run.continue`,
`interaction.respond`, `result.assess`, and `witness.admit` shall route through
one typed public-invocation admission boundary. Every accepted variant that
changes or attests runtime truth shall produce actor-attributed admitted event
truth. Admission shall not make ingress the owner of One Surface
orchestration.

**REQ-P-POLICY-043**: Install, configuration, and release operations shall
produce typed manifest or provenance truth appropriate to their product
boundary. They shall not be represented as ordinary traversal events merely to
share a transport adapter.

constraints.statement: run.invoke/continue, interaction.respond, result.assess and witness.admit route through one typed public-invocation boundary; accepted runtime mutation/attestation creates attributed admitted event, without ingress owning One Surface. Install/config/release produce appropriate manifests/provenance and are not forced into traversal events for adapter sharing.

conditions: F_P response failure classification applies after successful dispatch.
exceptions: Deterministic preflight/admission failures consume no F_P retry budget.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-046**: Deterministic configuration, product binding, catalog,
allowlist, input-contract, and capability failures shall be typed preflight or
admission results and shall not consume an F_P retry budget. Malformed,
incomplete, or contradictory F_P output after successful dispatch shall remain
typed retry, rejection, or blocked non-close truth under its declared response
contract.

constraints.statement: Deterministic config/binding/catalog/allowlist/input-contract/capability failure is typed preflight/admission and consumes no F_P retry budget. Malformed/incomplete/contradictory F_P output after successful dispatch is typed retry/rejection/blocked non-close under declared response contract.

dispositions.reason: Retain Product policy, replay hold, modes, handoff, operator and tenant boundaries.
Retain closed public-family meaning and parity; referenced complete family remains external.
Retain direct/supervised authority distinction, public Run paths and reads; referenced contracts remain external.
Retain pure gap/action reads, deferred native human response, automatic 5.0 work and lawful re-entry.
Retain assessment/witness domains, reserved variants, conformance and exact snapshot gate.
Retain read/mutation/manifest separation, thin adapters and deterministic versus F_P failure classes.

allowed: Consume GTL tags, evaluator results and convergence state.
forbidden: Embed policy logic in GTL validation or HoG kernel.
Create independent boolean lifecycle truth in CLI/control projections.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-001**: Product policy (feature closing, visibility rules, human proxy mode, CLI behavior) shall be expressed as product-layer requirements, not GTL language law, HoG traversal law, or ABG admission law.

**REQ-P-POLICY-002**: Policy may consume GTL tags, evaluator results, and convergence state, but policy logic shall not be embedded in GTL validation or the HoG traversal kernel.

**REQ-P-POLICY-003**: CLI and control-plane summaries shall be product-layer projections over canonical ABG run truth. They shall not define independent boolean lifecycle truth that can contradict the canonical run/event model.

allowed: Website/service/installer shells bind the public contract.
Claude/Codex/Gemini transports bind the same interactive agentic-coder Product law.
Tenants vary executable prefix, install mechanics and package bindings.
forbidden: Create rival control models or tenant-specific operator language; command suffix subcommands, flags, target/control grammar, output and stop classification must agree.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-015**: Website, service, or installer shells may bind the
public operator contract, but they shall remain delivery bindings. The primary
flexible operator surface shall remain interactive work with an agentic coder
interface over substrate truth. Concrete transports such as `claude`, `codex`,
or `gemini` are bindings of that same product law, not rival control models.

**REQ-P-POLICY-016**: Product-layer stop, hold, and gap reporting for the
interactive operator workflow shall be explicit enough that an operator can
decide the next lawful action: continue by restarting `start`, inspect
with `gaps`, remove an ambiguity, satisfy a missing capability, or supply
human decision. Downstream wrappers shall not need to reconstruct that next
step from hidden controller-local state.

**REQ-P-POLICY-017**: Public command-line grammar shall be tenant-invariant
for supported GTL/ABG operator commands. Python, TypeScript, or any other
tenant may use different executable prefixes, installation mechanics, or
package bindings, but the command suffix after the binary shall preserve the
same subcommands, public flags, target grammar, control-mode grammar, output
contract, and stop classification. A tenant-specific binary shall bind the
shared product command grammar; it shall not define a rival operator command
language.

allowed: CLI parses, validates, invokes and renders public SDK/contracts.
Hosts delegate to same public SDK or CLI.
forbidden: CLI imports private runtime authority, calls workers/emits events, constructs continuation, retries traversal, ranks private actions, widens catalog/allowlist or decides closure.
Host copies GraphFunction logic, owns catalog/truth store, calls workers, selects private traversal, emits events, manages continuation/retry or becomes required for native operation.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-044**: A public CLI shall be a thin adapter over the public SDK
and operation contracts. It may parse, validate, invoke, and render those
contracts; it shall not import private runtime authority, call workers directly,
emit runtime events directly, construct continuations, retry traversal, rank
private actions, widen catalog or allowlist views, or decide closure.

**REQ-P-POLICY-045**: A Codex, Claude, service, website, manager, or other host
adapter shall delegate to the same public SDK or CLI operation contract. It
shall not copy GraphFunction logic, own a catalog or truth store, call workers
directly, select private traversal, emit ABG events, manage continuation or
retry, or become required for native ABG operation.

limitations: Requirements and future-scope contracts are source data, not assertions of availability, execution or acceptance.
Referenced complete operation catalog, Product synthesis/evaluation contracts and TICKET_METHOD require source re-entry.
The model retains sequencing and authority as descriptive records rather than operational judgments or transformations.

grounding.quote:
**REQ-P-POLICY-023**: The `start` variant of
`abg.operation.run.invoke` shall accept one admitted traversal request with
`scope`, public `target`, and `until`, plus declared session policy and
capability inputs such as control modes and catalog view. It shall resolve only
public target identities inside one admitted GTL program and shall return a
typed run and GraphCall identity, current disposition, stop or terminal
classification, and relevant result, gap, interaction, evidence, and replay
references. Public ingress admits and transports the request. GTL owns the

relations.meaning: start consumes an admitted traversal request and declared session-policy/capability inputs.

residuals.consequence: Local concepts do not resolve cross-chunk endpoints or infer current availability/qualification of reserved human variants.

grounding.quote:
When `root_mode = direct`, `start` selects one admitted entry traversal without
requiring One Surface, `evaluateNext`, or a `ConstructionIntent`. When
`root_mode = supervised`, it selects the admitted standard system program and
that program owns One Surface semantic ordering and action topology;
Product-owned GraphFunctions own the four synthesis and evaluation contracts,
and ABG separately admits selected-action and construction-intent truth. Neither
the program nor HoG may mint runtime truth, and ABG shall not reorder semantic
authorities, select traversal topology, or become a scheduler.

**REQ-P-POLICY-018**: Gap triage shall be downstream product policy expressed
through published graph-function-addressable work. ABG may expose replay-derived
gap, hold, stop, continuation, and unresolved-observation truth, but it shall
not own ticket priority, ticket closure, backlog state, or process mechanics.
When a downstream product creates or changes a ticket from gap truth, that
behavior shall be governed by the downstream product and `TICKET_METHOD.md`.

residuals.uncertainty: REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-008 supplies the complete operation family outside this chunk; four Product synthesis/evaluation contracts and TICKET_METHOD are referenced without full definitions.
